sq.q: What is the purpose of an interactive form?
answer: To collect and process user input via the GUI.

sq.q: Name two common widgets in Tkinter.

lq.q: Analyze the structure and role of different Tkinter widgets in building interactive forms.
answer: Tkinter widgets allow structured user interaction. For example:

from tkinter import * def greet(): name = entry.get() label.config(text=f"Hello, {name}!") window = Tk() entry = Entry(window) entry.pack() Button(window, text="Submit", command=greet).pack() label = Label(window, text="") label.pack() window.mainloop()
window = Tk() entry = Entry(window) entry.pack() Button(window, text="Submit", command=greet).pack() label = Label(window, text="") label.pack() window.mainloop()
This form collects input and responds dynamically. Analyzing widget roles helps in designing intuitive UIs.
